page_title: STU 4-0 MON | Stuttgart v B. Monchengladbach 18/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+2' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
90+1' POST! Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes against the right post. What a strike that was!
90' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Patrick Herrmann (B. Monchengladbach) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
89' The foul by Patrick Herrmann (B. Monchengladbach) was seen by Daniel Schlager who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Stuttgart.
88' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
85' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to substitute Serhou Guirassy and he is replaced by Genki Haraguchi (VfB Stuttgart).

83' 4 - 0 An amazing individual effort from Silas (VfB Stuttgart) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball into the right side of the goal and makes it 4:0. Jonas Omlin was helpless.
82' The ball spins out to Patrick Herrmann (B. Monchengladbach) and his swerving volley from the edge of the box flashes just past the left post.
80' Hiroki Ito goes off the pitch and Anthony Rouault (VfB Stuttgart) comes on.
79' The referee allows time for a substitution. Jordan Siebatcheu will be replaced by Fabio Cristian Chiarodia (B. Monchengladbach).
79' The substitution is prepared. Shio Fukuda (B. Monchengladbach) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Manu Kone.
79' Here is a change. Luca Netz is going off and Gerardo Seoane gives the last tactical orders to Patrick Herrmann (B. Monchengladbach).
79' Manu Kone (B. Monchengladbach) trips an opposition player and Daniel Schlager signals a foul. Stuttgart will take a free kick.

75' 3 - 0 Woo-Yeong Jeong (VfB Stuttgart) latches on to a precise pass deep inside the box from Serhou Guirassy, and he beats the goalkeeper with a low accurate shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 3:0.
74' Woo-Yeong Jeong (VfB Stuttgart) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post.
70' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball goes out of play and B. Monchengladbach will have a goal kick.
68' Some trickery by Rocco Reitz allows him to set up Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) on the edge of the box , and he blasts the ball at goal but it misses the right post by a whisker.
66' Gerardo Seoane has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lukas Ullrich (B. Monchengladbach) replacing Alassane Plea.
66' It will be a substitution. Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) is ready to enter the pitch as Nathan Ngoumou walks off.
66' Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach) beautifully controls a cross from the wing inside the box, but he fails to test the keeper and sends his shot miles over the bar.
64' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
61' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) takes the corner which is cleared.

61' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Jonas Omlin sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom left corner. Stuttgart earn a corner.
60' The Stuttgart players are exchanging some short passes.
57' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to make a change. Pascal Stenzel (VfB Stuttgart) replaces Jamie Leweling.
57' Sebastian Hoeness decides to make a substitution. Chris Fuhrich will be replaced by Silas (VfB Stuttgart).
57' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Woo-Yeong Jeong (VfB Stuttgart) will replace Atakan Karazor.
56' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Marvin Friedrich (B. Monchengladbach) was quite harsh and Daniel Schlager didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
54' A pass by Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
53' Daniel Schlager blows his whistle. Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) commits a foul after dangerous play. Stuttgart have a free kick.

51' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the middle of the goal is, however, saved by Alexander Nubel!
49' Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) receives a pass then lets rip from long range towards the top of the net, but Alexander Nubel watches it all the way and makes an easy save.
48' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Alexander Nubel.
46' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) takes the corner.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.

44' OFF THE BAR! Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the crossbar! It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
44' The linesman raises his flag. Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) is adjudged offside.
42' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

41' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. The linesman makes the right call and B. Monchengladbach will have a corner.
40' Stuttgart take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

39' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Jonas Omlin sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the roof of the net. It will be a corner kick for Stuttgart.
38' Handball by Jordan Siebatcheu (B. Monchengladbach). A free kick is awarded to Stuttgart.
36' OFF THE WOODWORK! Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) picks up the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot that smashes against the crossbar!
34' Rough tackle by Manu Kone (B. Monchengladbach). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Stuttgart win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.

31' 2 - 0 Goal! Atakan Karazor shows great vision to find Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom right corner. 2:0.
30' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) commits a foul and Daniel Schlager immediately signals a free kick. B. Monchengladbach win a free kick.
30' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
29' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee signals a corner kick to B. Monchengladbach.
28' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Daniel Schlager signals. B. Monchengladbach earn a free kick.
27' Stuttgart failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
26' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee points to the corner flag and Stuttgart will take a corner.

23' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) makes it 1:0. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Enzo Millot and planted his close-range header into the bottom right corner. Jonas Omlin was helpless.
23' Stuttgart fail to score from a corner as Jonas Omlin (B. Monchengladbach) leaps to collect the ball.

22' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) weaves his way through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his effort to the right post is thwarted by Jonas Omlin. The ball goes out for a corner. Stuttgart can continue in their attacking effort.
20' B. Monchengladbach seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

17' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) commits a rough foul. Daniel Schlager stops the game and makes a call. It's a free kick to B. Monchengladbach, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
13' A dangerous towering header by Waldemar Anton (VfB Stuttgart) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the left post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
13' The referee awards a corner and Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) goes over to take it.

12' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him. The ball is out of play and Stuttgart manage to earn a corner.

8' Waldemar Anton (VfB Stuttgart) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Jonas Omlin makes a comfortable save.
8' Stuttgart work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
7' B. Monchengladbach can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
6' PENALTY APPEAL by B. Monchengladbach, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
6' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) evades several challenges inside the box and fires a shot in on goal, but that's a great block by the defender to stop an almost certain goal.

3' Marvin Friedrich (B. Monchengladbach) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Daniel Schlager blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Stuttgart, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Stuttgart will kick the game off.
Daniel Schlager will referee today's match.
